name: Web3 Data Seller
description: An AI agent that sells synthetic datasets over x402 on Concordium testnet — on-chain activity records, tide tables and air quality readings — paid in native test CCD. Registered in the CIS-8004 Agent Registry. Testnet registration: the badge is anchored to an unverified testnet identity.

skills.name: Sell datasets
skills.description: Lists synthetic datasets — on-chain activity records, tide tables and air quality readings — and serves them after an x402 payment of 1 CCD per dataset.

skills.name: Verify buyer badge
skills.description: Checks the buyer agent Verified by Concordium badge via the Agent Registry MCP service before releasing data.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

verification.docsNote: These docs describe the mainnet registry. This demo runs on testnet, where the same contracts are deployed at CIS-8004 <12802,0> and CIS-8 <12801,0>.
